name: Bitter Downfall
oracle_text:
This spell costs {3} less to cast if it targets a creature that was dealt damage this turn.
Destroy target creature. Its controller loses 2 life.
blocked_sentences: This spell costs {3} less to cast if it targets a creature that was dealt damage this turn.

needs.what: a `damaged` (was dealt damage this turn) key in cost_reduction_filter_keys, so a card's `cost_reduction` of `{"amount": 3, "targeting": {"types": ["Creature"], "damaged": true}}` discounts the cast when its chosen creature target has been dealt damage this turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `targeting` reads only cost_reduction_filter_keys (attacking, tapped, entered_this_turn, ...), which has no damage-this-turn key; the effect selector key `damaged` exists but the notes say any key outside cost_reduction_filter_keys is a load error, and a `condition` with `exists` would discount regardless of what the spell targets
